about: Pinned solvers of the SL-16 mechanism programs (core/mechanisms/solver.py), one per program class, through cvxpy. A status other than accepted_status excludes the market (it is counted, never used).

qp.method: interior point, then an exact active-set polish (allocation.polish)

platform_check.rule: DEPENDENCIES.md (ai-agents): production Linux x86_64, development macOS arm64; a package that is unavailable or different on either needs a platform marker.
platform_check.method: PyPI file listings of the pinned releases (pip's index cache from the 2026-10-23 install; no network access from the check) and the installed wheel tags in .venv-storelab (macOS arm64, Python 3.11.1).
platform_check.result: Binary wheels for CPython 3.11 exist on both platforms for every pinned package, so no platform marker is needed. On Linux, cvxpy, osqp and scs wheels require glibc >= 2.28 (manylinux_2_28); clarabel requires glibc >= 2.17. numpy 1.26.4 and scipy 1.17.1 are unchanged.
